home_hero_description: The first technology consultancy and custom software studio on the triple border. Built by Indigenous people, for organisations in every sector and for Indigenous peoples.
home_vision_title: Those who live the context build the solution.
home_vision1_desc: We design for slow internet, shared devices and field use, where a lot of software stops working.
home_vision2_desc: Respect for each people's culture, language and data. Clean code, documentation and training: communities and clients maintain what we deliver.
home_vision3_desc: Mature technology, chosen to last for years rather than for the trend of the moment.
home_process_desc: The same team stays with you from the first call until the system is live, without handing the project to anyone else.
home_step1_desc: We learn the business, review systems and processes, and define success before any code.
home_step2_desc: Architecture, stack choices, roadmap and clear estimates. You decide with the facts in hand.
home_step3_desc: Websites, systems and APIs shipped in short cycles, with a working version to try every week.
home_step4_desc: After launch we monitor, fix and improve. The product keeps getting better with use.
home_services_heading: From consulting to a system in production.
home_service_consulting_desc: We help your organisation decide what to build, and what not to build, before spending on it.
home_team_desc: Developers, designers and analysts, Indigenous and native to the Upper Solimões.
home_role1_desc: Systems and infrastructure built to hold up in the field.
home_role2_desc: Clear interfaces for the people who use them, on any screen.
home_role3_desc: Data and processes understood before they become code.
home_cta_desc: Tell us what your organisation, company, institution or community needs. We reply within one working day.
home_service_web_desc: Custom websites and web systems in React and TypeScript, quick to load and easy to maintain.
home_service_backend_desc: Server-side systems on AdonisJS, Fastify and Node.js, with REST APIs and real-time updates.
home_service_design_desc: Accessible interfaces written the way their users talk, in Portuguese, Spanish, English and the community's own language when it asks.
home_service_impact_desc: Association management, member registry, documents and a site of their own, with the data under the community's control.
blog_description: What we learn building software on the triple border.
blog_article_cta_description: Maiyu is with you at every step, from the first conversation to the live system.
blog_article_not_found: This piece doesn't exist, or was never published.
career_hero_description: We don't always have open positions. Write to us with your field, and we call when a project needs your work.
contact_page_title: Tell us about your technology challenge.
contact_page_description: We read every message and reply within one working day. Someone from the team answers.
portfolio_hero_description: A Ticuna association and people learning technology for free already use these systems; the city hall, a school and people looking for housing in Benjamin Constant are validating the others with us. See what we built and who we built it with.
footer_tagline: Custom software built by Indigenous people, on the triple border of Brazil, Peru and Colombia.
site_description: Custom software and tech consulting in Benjamin Constant, on the triple border near Tabatinga and Leticia. Built by Indigenous people.
home_roots_title: We are Indigenous and native to the Upper Solimões.
home_roots_desc: Maiyu was born in Benjamin Constant, where Brazil meets Peru and Colombia. The people who design, code and answer here grew up between the river, the forest and the villages of the region.
home_roots_fact1_desc: An office in Benjamin Constant, with the team living in the region.
home_roots_fact2_desc: Brazil, Peru and Colombia, one boat crossing from our office.
home_roots_fact3_desc: Portuguese, Spanish and English, from the first call to delivery.
home_audience_desc: Organisations in every sector that need technology made with care, starting with the ones big consultancies tend to ignore.
home_audience_reach: In Brazil, Peru, Colombia and anywhere Indigenous peoples live.
career_areas_description: Three lines of work. Write to us about the one closest to what you do.
career_area_development_desc: Custom websites and systems, from the database to the screen.
career_area_design_desc: Clear, accessible interfaces, tested with the people who will use them.
career_area_data_desc: Understand the problem, organise the information and turn it into a decision.
career_welcome_title: We especially want to hear from Indigenous people and people from the region.
career_welcome_body: Maiyu was born in Benjamin Constant and is made by Indigenous people and locals. If you live on the triple border, or belong to an Indigenous people in any country, the door is open. Speaking Spanish, English or an Indigenous language counts in your favour.
career_principle1_desc: The people who design and code know the place the software is made for, because it is theirs.
career_principle2_desc: Portuguese, Spanish and English are part of every project from the start.
career_principle3_desc: What we build is documented and handed to the client, who keeps the system running without depending on us.
career_principle4_title: Projects that matter in the region
career_principle4_desc: The systems we build are used every day by people from the region itself.
career_meta_title: Tech careers in the Upper Solimões
career_meta_description: Maiyu talent pool for development, design and data. We invite Indigenous people and locals of the Upper Solimões, on the triple border.
contact_page_languages: We work in Portuguese, Spanish and English.
contact_page_audience: Organisations of any sector and Indigenous peoples of any country.
contact_page_meta_description: Ask for a conversation about custom software or tech consulting. We work in Portuguese, Spanish and English, in Benjamin Constant.
meta_home_title: Custom software in Benjamin Constant, Brazil
channels_notice_title: The form is offline for now
channels_notice_body: You can't send a message from this page right now. Write to Maiyu by email or message us on WhatsApp, and the conversation continues there.
career_contact_subtitle: Tell us what you work on and, if you have one, send a link to your portfolio. We read every message personally.
